title: Admin reviews Attendance Log
description: Open Attendance Log, switch status filters (Present / Out), and use From / To dates to review a specific club day.

steps.title: Admin home
steps.body: Attendance Log is under the Admin menu alongside Payment Log and Plans.

steps.title: Open Attendance Log
steps.body: Attendance Log lists check-ins for the club — who is Present, who is Out, and rejected attempts.

steps.title: Today’s visits
steps.body: The seeded log mixes Present members, people who already checked Out, and a Rejected attempt. Status filters narrow that list.
steps.resultNote: Title Present count reflects who is still in the club right now.

steps.title: Show Present only
steps.body: Turn off Out and Rejected so only Present remains — the most useful day-of view of who is in the club now.

steps.title: Who is Present
steps.body: Only Present rows remain. This is the practical front-desk view while the club is open.
steps.resultNote: Present filter on; Out and Rejected off.

steps.title: Show Out only
steps.body: Switch to Out to see who already left (manual or auto check-out). Rejected attempts use the Rejected filter the same way.

steps.title: Who is Out
steps.body: Only Out rows remain — members who checked in earlier and already left today.
steps.resultNote: Out filter on; Present and Rejected off.

steps.title: Date filters
steps.body: From and To sit next to Status. Set both to the same club date to focus on one day, or widen the range for history.

steps.title: Day-scoped list
steps.body: With From and To set, the list only includes visits in that club-date window. Combine dates with Status to reconstruct a past day.
steps.resultNote: Date range + status filters work together.

steps.title: Look back in time
steps.body: To review another day, change From and To to that club date and flip Present / Out / Rejected as needed.
